# V58 independent same-build comparison

The supplied Forge and Salient artifacts agree on the new Polder movement build. This is an artifact comparison, not formal candidate acceptance or proof of automated trait execution. Machine-readable results are in [comparison.json](comparison.json).

- [Forge export](forge/v58-polder-new.ds-hero) is structurally identical to current main's `tests/fixtures/v45-reference/Bethell-corrected-export.ds-hero` outside `ancestry.features[id=polder-feature-3].data.selected`. The only replacement is Nimblestep, Polder Geist and Reactive Tumble.
- [Persisted Salient readback](salient/readback.json) matches every `tests/fixtures/v25-bethell.json` selection with that same replacement, ignoring authored name. Evaluation is complete with no diagnostics. Skills and languages match the baseline exactly.
- [Forge sheet](forge/v58-polder-new-sheet.png) / [text](forge/v58-polder-new-sheet.txt) agree with Salient on M/A/R/I/P −1/1/2/2/1, Stamina 18, Recoveries 8, recovery value 6, size 1S, speed 5, stability 0, Disengage 1, save 6+, renown 1 and wealth 1. Salient additionally reports winded 9 and potency 0/1/2. Purchased traits cost 2+1+1=4. No always-on speed increase or removed Graceful Retreat bonus remains.

Expected values were independently checked against current main's pinned Compendium `fb83a789da8f0327a389c277a0c790b1648d5810`, using `en/unified/md/` paths: `class/elementalist.md`, `feature/trait/polder/{polder-traits,nimblestep,polder-geist,reactive-tumble,small,shadowmeld}.md`, `rule/character/speed.md`, `feature/common/move-actions/disengage.md`, `rule/health/{recoveries,winded}.md`, `rule/general/saving-throw.md`, `career/mages-apprentice.md`, and `rule/resource/{renown,wealth}.md`. No Opus evidence was consulted.

Nimblestep ignores difficult terrain and permits full-speed sneaking. Polder Geist grants its +3 speed only for the specified combat turn-start visibility condition, through turn end. Reactive Tumble permits a free triggered shift 1 after forced movement resolves. These remain manual effects. Forge represents Reactive Tumble as an Ability and lists it under Triggered Actions; Salient represents it as a purchased trait with complete readable [source text](salient/reactive-tumble.png), absent from `baseline.abilities`. This is a presentation/model distinction, not missing rules text or an automation claim.

No unresolved rules or numeric discrepancy was found in this comparison. One incidental presentation issue is visible in [reloaded wizard](salient/reloaded-wizard.png): Shadowmeld is printed twice under Signature Trait, while the baseline contains only one Shadowmeld ability. The readback proves a complete persisted draft; `derivedBaseline`, `effectiveRevision`, and `liveState` are null, so it does not establish activation or table behavior. Full candidate checks and formal review remain separate gates.
